CaptureCompletion.description: The producer's claim about the items it sent on a handle.

oneOf.description: Every item was sent; the cursor must match.
Some items are known to be absent; the recorder names missing positions.
The producer stopped or restarted and cannot vouch for its stream.

ChannelInventory.description: Declared completeness of one collection channel.

completeness.description: Completeness the producer claims for the channel.

ExecutionReport.description: Execution outcome as reported by the producer.

exit_code.description: Exit code, when the action had one. It implies no measurement validity.

state.description: Reported state; `unknown` when the producer cannot tell what happened.

ExternalReceipt.description:
Reference to an external receipt about the action.

The capture form of the envelope's `ProducerReceipt`: the same fields, with
the receipt bytes named by an attached item key instead of an artifact path.

artifact.description: Item key of an attached artifact holding the receipt bytes.

kind.description: Receipt kind in the producer's vocabulary; never interpreted. See `format`.

reference.description: External locator, retained as an unverified reference.

Knowledge.description: Explicit unknown is distinct from a known zero, empty string, or empty list.

Position.description:
One-based position of an accepted item within a capture handle.

Appended facts and attachment descriptors share one sequence. The recorder
accepts only the next expected position, so a lost middle item is detectable.

ProducerAssertion.description:
A producer-reported result, such as a metric.

It is retained as the producer's assertion. Only an attributed Assessment or
Conclusion can promote it to an investigative interpretation.

ProducerControl.description: A control the producer reports with its own result.

producer_result.description: Producer's result, such as `reported_pass`. It is not proof of method.

ReceiptFormat.description:
Declared receipt format. No format is inferred from bytes, a kind or a
media type.

oneOf.description: A DSSE envelope carrying an in-toto Statement.
An RFC 3161 TimeStampToken or TimeStampResp, DER encoded.

SourceTime.description: The original time and offset are source claims and must not determine ordering.

ValidityClaim.description:
How valid the producer says an assertion is. The only accepted claim is
`producer_reported`: a producer cannot declare its own result verified.

description:
Final summary of a capture.

Recording completeness, execution outcome and the producer's own assertions
stay separate: a failed execution can be finalized completely, and a
successful one can be finalized as partial.

assertions.description: Producer results, retained as attributed producer assertions.

completion.description: The producer's claim about its own stream of items.

controls.description: Controls the producer reports, retained as its claims.

declared_artifacts.description:
Item keys of every artifact the producer meant to attach. Without
strict inventory, absent attachments are recorded as missing.

execution.description: Execution outcome as the producer reports it.

expected_last_position.description:
Last position the producer believes was accepted; `None` if it sent no items.

A `complete` claim with a stale cursor is rejected.

key.description: Journal command ID for the finalizing transaction.

receipts.description: References to external receipts about the action.

strict_artifact_inventory.description:
Require declared artifact keys to match acknowledged attachment keys
before sealing. Only valid with `completion: complete`.
